value.title: Receipt-a closeout: complex-termite

sections.name: body
sections.value:
pij-complex-termite held performance/receipt-a for pij-multiple-nightingale's quiet spawn-count receipt. Before the close-time memory request, it loaded pij and builder, then waited: no shell commands, peer sends, measurements or verdicts. No review or AFTER work was assigned or remains in flight from this seat.

This closeout adds this seat's activity record, not a new performance conclusion. The existing 2026-11-25-prd-008-receipt-only-seat-no-measurement note carries the shared proof limits; the parent owns any measurement receipts. Memory lookup and this write belong to closeout, not the quiet observation interval.
